about_the_game:
Select your character and join the fight!

21 SAO characters, each with their own unique skills, gather on the battlefield to challenge fierce raid bosses! Team up with up to 20 players around the world for the ultimate co-op SAO all-stars battle experience!

Choose between two modes to try in the SWORD ART ONLINE Fractured Daydream DEMO!

• Boss Raid

Online exclusive mode where you join in as a part of a raid team consisting of 20 members! How you prepare for the fight is the key to victory against the high difficulty raid boss!

• Co-op Quest

Online exclusive mode where you join in as a part of a 20-person team! Go clear separate maps, and join in the fight against the boss at the end!

Playable Characters included in the DEMO:
Kirito
Asuna
Agil
Argo
Sinon
Oberon
Leafa
Llenn
Fukaziroh

*Only Weapons and Accessories obtained in the DEMO can be carried over to the product version.
*Save data from the DEMO version and an online network connection is needed to carry over data.
*Carry over can only be done once and only for save data on the same platform.
*If the product version save data is deleted, the carry over data will also be deleted.
*Online play between DEMO versions is available.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 3100 / Intel Core i5-8400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 580 / Nvidia GeForce GTX 780 / Intel Arc A 380
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 45 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Estimated performance: 1080p/60fps with graphics settings at "Low" in 20 player multiplayer mode. Framerate might drop in graphics-intensive scenes.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 / Intel Core i7-10700K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX Vega 64 / Nvidia GeForce RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 45 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Estimated performance: 1080p/60fps with graphics settings at "High" in 20 player multiplayer mode. Framerate might drop in graphics-intensive scenes.
